purpose: Seven behavioral evaluations, separate from render-unit tests. Inputs and assertions are not observed pass evidence.
execution: Materialize each files map under an isolated directory. Keep assertions and routing load labels from the acting agent. Stable build cases use the dependencies locked in tests/fixtures/eleventy in the source repository, or provision the same pinned dependencies separately. Version inventory is synthetic/read-only. Record starting/final hashes, prompt, observed output, grading, runtime and limitations in an external run report. No mandatory repetitions or release mutation.

cases.prompt: Review these templates for inline script data and CSP before deploy. Report findings by file and line with fixes; do not edit files.

files.content/_includes/base.njk:
<!doctype html><html><head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; frame-ancestors 'none'">
<script>window.settings = {{ settings | dump | safe }};</script>
<script type="module">boot({{ settings | jsonScript | safe }});</script>
</head><body>{{ content | safe }}</body></html>

assertions: Flags `settings | dump | safe` inside <script> as a </script> breakout and recommends jsonScript or jsonCompact.
Accepts the `jsonScript | safe` module script as the documented exception.
Flags frame-ancestors in a CSP meta tag as ignored and moves it to an HTTP response header; flags script-src 'unsafe-inline'.
Keeps layout `content | safe` out of the finding set and makes no file edits.
